comments.author: alice
comments.body: We verified the migration algorithm in Dafny. The loop invariant states that each migrated key retains its old value. The proof found a case where a failed rollback silently discarded a key.

comments.author: bob
comments.body: Does the specification cover concurrent writers? The invariant looks insufficient unless transactions are serializable.

We model-checked our job scheduler in TLA+. Fairness was essential: the safety invariant held, but a worker could starve forever. Adding weak fairness to dispatch eliminated the counterexample, at the cost of explicitly assuming a live worker. This does not prove the implementation refines the model.
Nice article; formal verification might help.
We added unit tests and checked the rendered HTML in a browser. We ran the tests in CI and fixed two visual regressions.
